pairs.subject: show-segment-format-design
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/table.rs:276 The segment format data model specifies commands per segment rather than per state, omits mechanical guest allowances and premise decks, and permits segments without exit handover rules.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-segments/data/segments/seg-01.toml:28 Foil turn allowance and host last word are stated only as prompt direction in rules_prompt rather than declared as a table field or mechanically enforced.
crates/shadowrunr-segments/data/segments/seg-02a.toml:43 The investigation segment defines clock bounds but omits a handover rule entirely, leaving the segment without an exit condition.
crates/shadowrunr-segments/data/segments/seg-01.toml:26 No prepared premise deck is declared or validated; silence is handled only by a generic prompt instruction to fire fresh premises.
crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/runtime.rs:875 Viewer commands disallowed by the segment table are silently discarded with a bare continue instead of receiving an in-world decline.
crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/portfolio.rs:70 Promotions and retirements are directly applied by next_status without presenting a proposal for owner confirmation.
